Name: Disable Sora body separation
Description: Owned override for the current Sora actor. Sora stops participating in body-to-body separation; world collision and hit detection keep their own rules. Native preexisting overrides are not acquired.
RestoreBehavior: The owned bit is released on disable or stale heartbeat only while the same allocated actor/status, form, map, scheduler and heap remain valid. Identity loss abandons the old actor without writes. Profile application explicitly enables the override once; no automatic reapplication after actor/scene changes. Native same-value flag reuse cannot be distinguished without a generation token. If a concurrent writer changes the flags during restore, the compare-and-swap conflict relinquishes ownership; the separation bit may remain set until a native reset. Restore is not guaranteed after lost identity or ownership.

Evidence.Finding: Actor+288 bit2 excludes the actor from both sides of body separation.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and synthetic memory tests; no live-game validation.
